content:
OpenAI has announced that over 20 announcements will be made at the DevDay 2026 event. The event will be livestreamed. You can see everything announced today below.

OpenAI event livestream

We expect the main release at this event to be ChatGPT's response to SpaceXAI's Grok Bot and Meta's Muse, building on existing AI agent tools to attract a wider consumer base.

OpenAI already offers similar functionality under the umbrella of ChatGPT Work, though its presentation is less direct and simple than Muse and Grok Bot.

In any case, you can watch the livestream right on time. The event will begin at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time / 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

Dots, AI agents that run around the clock

The first announcement is dots. These are AI agents that run around the clock, a new feature within ChatGPT.

ChatGPT Space

Next up is a new feature called ChatGPT Space. This is a collaborative workspace where you can work with dots, manage pages and presentations, and handle live documents.

GPT-6.1 Sol

In addition, OpenAI has released information about the new GPT-6.1 Sol model.

OpenAI says: "We are officially launching GPT‑6.1 Sol, an upgraded version of GPT‑6 Sol. In agentic coding, computer use, and professional work, its intelligence is nearly on par with GPT‑6 Astra, but the standard token price for input and output is only one-fifth of Astra's."

OpenAI also noted: "Cached input costs just $0.10 per million tokens — 95% cheaper than standard input pricing and 50% cheaper than GPT‑6 Sol's cached input pricing — giving developers more room to build and run powerful agents that can reuse context across requests."

You can learn more about the new model here.

All the new releases

Although the launch event is still ongoing, the full summary of today's news is already available on OpenAI's official website, including a new subscription plan priced at $500 per month, and more. You can head over to read it.
